items.text: Steve Hilton is a former Fox News host who was a top adviser to British Prime Minister David Cameron from 2010 to 2012. In the United Kingdom, he helped design Cameron's "Big Society" policy to shift power from central government to local communities. His campaign centers on an affordability agenda, blaming the state's high cost of living on Democratic policies.

sentences.text: Steve Hilton is a former Fox News host who was a top adviser to British Prime Minister David Cameron from 2010 to 2012.
In the United Kingdom, he helped design Cameron's "Big Society" policy to shift power from central government to local communities.
His campaign centers on an affordability agenda, blaming the state's high cost of living on Democratic policies.

items.text: He has proposed eliminating state income taxes on the first $150,000 of earnings and pledges to reduce gas prices to $3 a gallon by reducing oil industry regulations and clean energy mandates. To offset the tax cuts, he says he would stop funding high-speed rail, trim state agencies by 5%, crack down on Medicaid fraud, and end state-funded health care for undocumented immigrants. On water, he supports increasing desalination and building more dams and reservoirs, including raising Shasta Dam. He wants to reduce environmental regulations, but opposes the Delta tunnel project.

items.text: He has called for overturning the state law that decriminalized sidewalk vending. He wants to cap vehicle registration fees at $73 and move routine services to county offices, abolishing the Department of Motor Vehicles as a stand-alone state agency. On homelessness, he says he would enforce existing laws and remove encampments from streets. He criticizes publicly funded harm-reduction programs that distribute clean drug supplies and says he would end them. He supports cooperating with federal immigration authorities in cases involving dangerous criminals. He supports a ban on artificial intelligence in classrooms.
